summary: Full regression HEALTH CHECK of FrameForge SaaS. Backend: 25/25 pytest smoke tests pass (login, wrong-pw, protected 401, 12 core GET endpoints, advisor 422 empty body, security headers, 8 public pages). Frontend: all 8 public pages + 15 authenticated /app/* pages render with valid h1 and no critical console errors (only 3x pre-login 401 already known & accepted, plus 1 CSP block on /app/live for Cloudflare Insights beacon). AI integrations verified live: /app/upgrade returned a real Claude-generated upgrade plan (+25-30% FPS @ 1440p, recommended parts, €599 total); /app/builds started the AI job (spinner 'L'AI sta assemblando la build perfetta...'); /app/advisor shows pre-generated personalized diagnosis card with 5 actions for the actual hardware (Ryzen 7 7700X + RTX 4070) — but there is NO visible chat textbox/input on the Advisor page, so 'send a new message' cannot be executed by a user. Language switch IT<->EN works, but two IT strings leak in EN mode: 'DA MIGLIORARE' badge on Dashboard health score and '5g fa' relative time in Admin users table. Wrong-login shows an error message. Logout works. Cookies banner + agent-update banner both dismissable.

ui_bugs.issue: No visible chat input/textarea to send a new message; only a pre-generated diagnosis card is shown. If chat is intended, the input is missing/hidden. If by design (proactive-only), the review-request expectation ('inviare UN messaggio breve') is out of sync with the implementation.

integration_issues.issue: CSP blocks https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js (script-src violation). Cosmetic (no user-facing feature broken) but noisy in console. Either add the CF Insights host to CSP script-src or remove the beacon tag.

issues: Italian label 'DA MIGLIORARE' shown inside the Health Score circle while UI language is set to English — i18n leak
Users table 'Signup' column renders '5g fa' (Italian short relative time) while UI language is English — locale-aware date formatter not switching with i18n locale
Card shows a large '0' with '-100% vs previous' — visually implies a regression when there is simply no comparable data; consider an empty-state instead of -100%

action_items: Decide whether /app/advisor is a chat (add textarea + send button) or a proactive diagnosis-only page (update spec/copy accordingly).

Fix i18n leaks: 'DA MIGLIORARE' badge on Dashboard health score and '5g fa' relative-time in Admin users table when EN is selected. Root cause likely a hardcoded IT string + a date formatter that doesn't read i18n locale.
Dashboard 'Benchmark & Trend' -100% vs previous — replace with proper empty state when there is no baseline.
Consider whitelisting static.cloudflareinsights.com in CSP script-src on /app/live (or remove the beacon).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth cookie handshake still emits 3x 401 in the console before the /auth/me completes — cosmetic, already accepted, but a small `credentials: 'include'` + gated initial fetch would remove them.

Relative-time strings (e.g. '5g fa', '3gg fa') appear across multiple screens (dashboard header 'SYNC SUGGERITO 3GG FA', admin table 5g fa) — centralize into a single i18n-aware formatter (Intl.RelativeTimeFormat with current locale) instead of ad-hoc Italian abbreviations.
Lab.jsx still >700 lines with ~13 sub-components (carried over from iter46/47) — refactor pending.

success_rate.frontend: 100% pages render; ~90% flows verified (advisor chat input missing prevents full advisor test)

seed_data_creation: None. Did not create products, did not start Lab sessions, did not alter snapshots. Only one upgrade AI call and one build-generate click were executed (per request budget of max 3 AI calls).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_full_regression_iter48.py — safe to re-run any time (idempotent). Public + all /app/* pages load fine. Known/accepted: 3x 401 pre-auth, price scraping falls back to manual, agent-dependent live telemetry empty in Linux preview. Newly reported: (1) missing advisor chat input, (2) IT strings 'DA MIGLIORARE' & '5g fa' leaking in EN, (3) CSP blocks CF Insights on /app/live. Nothing blocking.
rca of the issue: i18n leaks: (a) 'DA MIGLIORARE' is almost certainly a hardcoded Italian string inside the PCHealth score component (search for the literal in /app/frontend/src/components/**). (b) '5g fa'/'3gg fa' come from a custom Italian short relative-time formatter that isn't gated on the current locale — replace with `new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(i18n.language, { style: 'short' }).format(...)`. Advisor missing input: check /app/frontend/src/pages/Advisor.jsx (or components/Advisor/*) — the chat composer may be conditionally rendered on a flag/route (e.g. only when no diagnosis exists yet) and thus hidden once a diagnosis is present.
